location: England, Kent, East Farleigh, Gallant's Farm
description: Excavated by the Maidstone Area Archaeological Group over the last decade, they have identified what was originally thought to be a Roman villa, but is now understood as more likely to be a religious sanctuary. Complete with a Romano-Celtic temple, and other more unique features. The site seems to have been re-used for more mundane purposes at a later date, ovens being built into the temple.
